name: What kind of compensation can I receive after a semi-truck accident?

mainEntity.name: What kind of compensation can I receive after a semi-truck accident?

acceptedAnswer.text: Compensation in a semi-truck accident claim can cover a range of damages. This often includes medical expenses (past and future), lost wages or earning capacity, property damage to your vehicle, pain and suffering, emotional distress, and sometimes loss of consortium. The specific amount depends on the severity of your injuries, the impact on your life, and the specifics of the accident and liability established.
acceptedAnswer.description: Compensation can cover medical expenses, lost wages, property damage, pain and suffering, and emotional distress, varying based on injury severity and accident specifics.
